stanza: But I was wild once
And I can't forget it
I was wild, chasing stones

once.line: Suddenly every machine stopped at once
stanza: Suddenly every machine stopped at once
And the monitors beeped the last time
Hundreds of thousands of hospital beds
And all of them empty but mine

once.line: I followed in your footsteps once
stanza: I followed in your footsteps once
Back in my traveling days
Somewhere I failed to find your trail
Now I'm stumbling through the haze
But there's killers on the highway now
And a man can't get around
So I sold my soul for wheels that roll
Now I'm stuck here in this town

once.line: But for you, for you, for you, just once
stanza: I stopped my rambling
Never been once a gambler, my town
But for you, for you, for you, just once
It might be fine these days
These days

once.line: I loved real, real hard once
stanza: I loved real, real hard once
But the love wasn't returned
Found out the man I'd die for
He wasn't even concerned
I tried, and I tried, and I tried
To keep him in my life (To keep him in my life)
I cried, and I cried, and I cried
But I couldn't make it right

once.line: Let's not try to figure out everything at once
stanza: Turn the light out, say goodnight
No thinking for a little while
Let's not try to figure out everything at once
It's hard to keep track of you falling through the sky
This day was once
(Silently full)
Of grace, of lost
Can't wait at all
(Can't wait at all)
Temptation won
I went down to the dance
Such down by the wall
Invited to dance
By no one at all
The couples danced by
So charming and gay
But nobody once
Looked over my way
And all at once I knew
I knew at once
I knew he needed me
Until the day I die
I won't know why
I knew he needed me

once.linePrev: And I tell you the truth
once.lineNext: It's the last thing you wanted
